primary_comparison: new complete cumulative stack versus current cumulative stack; original remains frozen reference

accuracy.aggregate: equal-recording mean on common valid origins, compatible horizons and same targets
accuracy.allowance_meaning: initial engineering trade-off, not a measured noise confidence interval; freeze before future candidate evaluation

guards: No future observations or labels in inference
No manufactured rotor centers, force, identity or missing detections
Report common coverage and lost outputs instead of excluding difficult cases
Retain material failures and tail regressions
Measure the full combined version; independent gains cannot simply be added
semantics_preserving_optimizations: May enter the cumulative recipe based on preserved observation semantics and bounded execution; they need not improve point error themselves.
unverified_candidates: Keep as experiments, not discard merely for small gain; mixedFP16 needs RAW/trajectory evidence and investigation of logged cuDNN messages.
